items.excerpt: Zelenskyy says early warning system for Russian missile attacks resumes following call with Rubio KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday that Kyiv is once again receiving early warnings from its partners about incoming Russian missiles following recent strikes that he said occurred without enough notice, leaving civilians vulnerable. For at least a week, the Ukrainian leader has said that his country has not received early warnings about ballistic missiles aimed at the capital. Such intelligence, he said, saves lives by allowing the public to be alerted and giving military units time to try to intercept the missiles. Zelenskyy said the change happened after talks with his American counterparts, including a phone call with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio. “We are thankful that intelligence works now, and I’m speaking about early warning, which is very important for our people, for children, adults, civilians, because we can hear when ballistic is coming,” Zelenskyy said on a visit to Norway. “So we are thankful to American side now that it works.”

items.title: Fed up with Trump, Maine mulls sticking with GOP 'devil ...
items.excerpt: Early snow is already dusting the northeasternmost US state of Maine, where a canny 73-year-old Republican senator is having to run the race of her life to help save Donald Trump's party from being frozen out of power nationwide. Susan Collins has held her Senate seat for three decades, becoming a near immovable fixture in the state's political landscape. But with President Trump deeply unpopular nationwide and Mainers furious about surging fuel prices ahead of winter, Collins's Democratic challenger is eying an upset -- and a chance to make his party's outside bid to regain the Senate a reality. The stakes are enormous in the race between Collins and logger-turned-politician Troy Jackson, as Maine is crucial for any Democratic path to a US Senate majority. While Democrats are forecast to win the House of Representatives in the November 3 midterms, they would need to clinch the Senate too if they want to stop Trump's right-wing agenda in its tracks, including his power to nominate Supreme Court justices.

The U.S. official said Ukraine brought forward new ideas and proposals to the Oslo talks, which also involved the leaders of Norway and Finland and European and NATO representatives, and that participants made “meaningful progress” toward a coordinated approach to engaging Russia. The official, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, said the talks covered “key elements of a comprehensive peace framework,” including security guarantees for Ukraine, a post-war economic plan and a broader European security architecture.

items.title: United Nations report highlights significant increase in U.S. ...
items.excerpt: U.S. greenhouse gas emissions grew the most of any G20 country last year : NPR ... Countries are not doing enough to cut emissions that cause climate change, according to a new report from United Nations scientists. And the United States is a big part of the problem. The U.S. sticks out as the only major economy where planet-warming pollution increased dramatically last year, the report notes. ... It finds that last year, the U.S. was tied with Russia as the G20 countries with the most per capita emissions of carbon dioxide and other planet-warning gases. China emits significantly more total greenhouse gases each year than the U.S., but has more than four times the population. ... U.S. emissions grew because of increased electricity demand, as well as Trump administration policies that support the burning of fossil fuels. The Trump administration has ordered coal-fired power plants in the U.S. to stay open longer than planned, rolled back fuel-efficiency standards for vehicles and ended tax credits for solar and wind projects. Those policies have made the U.S. an outlier when it comes to escalating greenhouse gas emissions, says Inger Andersen, the executive director of the U.N. Environment Programme. ... The Trump administration has withdrawn from the 2015 Paris Climate Agreement, and is working to remove the U.S. from all U.N. climate work, arguing the international system imposes unfair burdens on Americans. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency now says greenhouse gases do not pose a threat to human health and welfare, reversing its previous position.

items.excerpt: Entertainment News (10/21/26) - BusinessWorld Online # Entertainment News (10/21/26) PRODUCER, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist Ziv has teamed up with rising P-pop girl group VVINK for “Trisikulo,” a pop track on the familiar third-wheel experience. October 20, 2026 | 6:06 pm ## Ziv, VVINK release collaboration PRODUCER, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist Ziv has teamed up with rising P-pop girl group VVINK for “Trisikulo,” a pop track on the familiar third-wheel experience. Released under Sony Music Entertainment, it is built around Filipino wordplay that links a tricycle’s three wheels to the feeling of being the extra person in someone else’s love story. The song was co-written by Ziv alongside Paolo Benjamin Guico of Filipino folk-pop band Ben&Ben and Angelika Samantha Ortiz, one of the songwriters behind BINI’s hit “Pantropiko.” The mixing was also done by Jacques Jenkins and mastering by Luna Tebbs. The track is out now on all digital music streaming platforms. ## *Love in Disguise* premieres on Prime Video *LOVE in Disguise*, a Korean series based on the hit web novel *Why Don’t You Know It’s a Girl?*, has premiered on Prime Video. It is directed by Park Dhan-hee and stars Yim Si Wan, Seorina, Kim Junghyun, and Yeonwoo. The genre-blending romance is exclusively seen on Prime Video in the Philippines and in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. ## Estelle Fly drops club-pop single SINGAPOREAN pop artist Estelle Fly has released “Shut It Down,” a playful club-pop single about switching off the overthinking and making the dance floor your own. Inspired by the Rihanna and Kesha songs, the new release is an invitation to let loose, dance with friends and have fun even when life feels complicated. It is out now on all digital music streaming platforms. ## Cayabyab, APO, Mitch Valdes reunion THIS holiday season, National Artist for Music Ryan Cayabyab, OPM legends APO, and performer Mitch Valdes will come together for *naRyan nAPO Kami*, the fourth chapter of the MaestroClass Concert Series. The shows will be held on Dec. 4, 5, and 6 at the Proscenium Theater at Rockwell Center, Makati. All shows take place at 7:30 p.m. Joined by the Ryan Cayabyab Singers, the special Christmas chapter of the concert series brings together familiar songs, stories, and artists in a celebration that captures the warmth and spirit of a Filipino family gathering. Tickets are available directly at the Proscenium Theater website via *https://prosceniumtheater.com/* and at the Power Plant Mall Cinema. ## *Amir* gets international distribution GMA Pictures, GMA Public Affairs, and Brightburn Entertainment have officially locked in a partnership deal with Columbia Pictures for the distribution of the upcoming fantasy-drama film and 52 nd Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) finalist *Amir*. It is directed by Zig Dulay, with a script crafted by National Artist for Film and Broadcast Arts Ricky Lee alongside Anj Atienza. The film’s cast features Dennis Trillo, Argus Aspiras, Glaiza de Castro, Will Ashley, Caprice Cayetano, Epy Quizon, Joel Saracho, Ronnie Lazaro, Laila Ulao, Heath Jornales, Yasser Marta, Mad Ramos, Ethan Hariot, Hebron Ecal, and Mon Confiado. ## Rachel Chinouriri releases new album UK’s indie-pop singer-songwriter Rachel Chinouriri has released her second studio album, I think I spoke too soon, via Atlas Artists/Parlophone Records. The album expands upon the pop, indie, and rock influences that Ms. Chinouriri has long used to sketch portraits of her inner world. The album’s focus track is “Pretty girls,” which celebrates women, self-confidence, and the freedom to express oneself without fear of judgement. ## M2M 2027 world tour has Manila leg NORWEGIAN pop duo M2M have announced that their global tour *TWO* will be coming to Manila in 2027. The tour will start in March and after concerts at Mexico, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Jakarta, M2M’s global tour will reach Manila on April 2, 2027, at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City. Tickets will go on sale on Oct. 24 at 10 a.m. via *TicketNet.com.ph* and TicketNet outlets nationwide. Presented by Wilbros Live, the concert will feature M2M performing their greatest hits, “Don’t Say You Love Me,” “Mirror Mirror,” “Pretty Boy,” and “The Day You Went Away,” among others. ## Maris Racal appears in Maya Black’s music video ACTRESS Maris Racal is featured in Maya Black’s latest music video, serving edgy looks against a hyperpop track. In the video, everything she wants turns into a miniature version of itself, bringing the song’s “make it mini” message to life. items.title: DWTS: Julia Stiles, 10 Things Cast Reunite in Heath Ledger Tribute
items.excerpt: For Dancing With the Stars Dedication Night Oct. 20, Julia Stiles reunited with the 10 Things I Hate About You cast to honor Heath Ledger, performing a routine set to "Can't Take My Eyes Off You." By Gabrielle Chung, Kisha Forde Oct 21, 2026 2:23 AM ... During Dancing With the Stars’ Dedication Night Oct. 20, the 10 Things I Hate About You actress paid tribute to her late costar Heath Ledger with heartfelt contemporary routine set to Frankie Valli's "Can't Take My Eyes Off You"—the same song Ledger’s character Patrick Verona sang to her character Kat Stratford in the 1999 movie—culminating in an emotional reunion with the rest of the cast. As Stiles wrapped up her dance with pro partner Ezra Sosa, she turned to a screen showing an image of Ledger as Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Gabrielle Union, Larisa Oleynik, Andrew Keegan and Susan May Pratt joined her on the dance floor for a group hug.

items.title: U.S. Premiere of LAIKA's 'Wildwood' to Open 40th AFI FEST | Animation World Network
items.excerpt: LAIKA has set the U.S. premiere of its highly-anticipated new film, Wildwood, at the 40th edition of AFI FEST presented by Canva on Wednesday, October 21, at the TCL Chinese Theatres in Hollywood, two days before the epic stop-motion fantasy hits theaters nationwide through Fathom Entertainment. The film is a long time coming: Travis Knight directs and produces from a screenplay by Chris Butler, based on the novel by Colin Meloy, which LAIKA optioned way back in 2011. Caleb Deschanel handles cinematography; Peyton Elizabeth Lee and Jacob Tremblay lead the voice cast, alongside Carey Mulligan, Academy Award winner Mahershala Ali, Angela Bassett, Awkwafina, Jake Johnson, Charlie Day, Amandla Stenberg, Jemaine Clement, Maya Erskine, Tantoo Cardinal, Tom Waits and Richard E. Grant. ... AFI FEST runs October 21-25 at the TCL Chinese Theatres, with Red Carpet Premieres, Special Screenings, World Cinema, Documentaries and Short Films. The full lineup will be unveiled September 29, individual tickets go on sale October 3, and passes are available now at FEST.AFI.com. The festival is an Academy Awards qualifying festival for the Live Action, Animated and Documentary Short Film categories.

items.excerpt: Dolly Parton’s life, music and humanitarian legacy will be celebrated in a two-hour live television special this fall. In an announcement made Wednesday, organizers confirmed that CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton will air October 21 on ABC and Disney+, with streaming available on Hulu the following day. The special, announced following Parton’s death on August 25 at age 80, will be filmed live at the Fisher Center for the Performing Arts at Belmont University in Nashville. Organizers say the program will combine musical performances, archival footage, and personal stories covering her career as a singer, songwriter, entertainer, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. ...
